name: Verity JE/BE Mod
tagline: Minecraft horror entity mod with AI dialogue and adaptive behavior
description: Verity is a Minecraft mod for both Java and Bedrock editions that adds horror entities with AI dialogue and adaptive behavior. Despite its youth — 104 stars and zero forks — the mod has already accumulated 8.6 million downloads across the community. A huge download base paired with a fresh GitHub presence makes it an interesting watch.

Supports both Java and Bedrock editions
